title: coleus minor
intro: Coleus minor, commonly known as Painted Nettle, is a flowering plant native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Coleus minor include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
